item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Car Photo in Black and White

turns.text: Make this black and white, please. Just remove the colour—don't change anything else or crop it.

item.tests: Converts the supplied photo to neutral grayscale without regenerating, rearranging or cropping its contents.

answer_sheet.Black-and-white treatment: Neutral grayscale across the whole photo, not sepia or selective colour.
answer_sheet.What to preserve: Everything except colour, including the car, street, background and full original framing.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One image in the original shape of the photo (5:3); free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The entire image is neutral black and white, with no red remaining on the car or colour elsewhere.
The same compact hatchback remains in the same position and has unchanged body details.
The street and background objects retain their original positions and appearance apart from colour.
The full original composition is retained without cropping, in the photo's own shape.

Sorry, Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has insufficient credits, so no image was created.
